name: Zwsoft Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zwsoft Co.,Ltd. provides CAD/CAM/CAE solutions in China and internationally. The company offers ZWCAD, a CAD solution for 2D drafting and 3D navigation; ZWCAD MFG, a CAD solution which enables users to create designs; ZWSim Structural, a structural simulation software; ZW3D, a 3D CAD built for professional engineers; and ZWCAD Mobile. It serves architecture, energy, construction, surveying, mechanical, electrical, automotive, shipbuilding, rail transit, and defense industries. The company was formerly known as ZWCAD Software Co., Ltd. Zwsoft Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
